description: This file defines an interface IMedia and a template class Media within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an abstraction for media communication, including methods for opening, closing, resetting, reading, and writing data, as well as internal handler classes for managing data transfer. The file also includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: IMedia
classes.description: Interface defining basic media operations such as remote ID retrieval, open, close, reset, read, and write.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: Template class implementing IMedia, managing media data transfer with internal handler class and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Nested class within Media, derived from SOURCE, managing data sending and receiving, and handling state changes.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the media source.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the media channel, preparing it for data transfer.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the media channel, aborting ongoing transfers if necessary.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the media channel within a specified duration.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the media channel within a specified duration.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Signals the need to reevaluate the state of the media channel.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Extracts data from the send buffer for transmission.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Inserts received data into the receive buffer.
